title: Glass Regular Mouth Mason Jars, 16 oz Clear Glass Jars with Silver Metal Lids for Sealing, Canning Jars for Food Storage, Overnight Oats, Dry Food, Snacks, Candies, DIY Projects (4PACK)
description:
About this item
CLEAR GLASS: The timeless clear finish of these canning jars looks elegant and rustic in your cupboards, shelves or refrigerator and allows you to easily identify contents. They're a handy, multi-purpose item for your kitchen, home, office or studio
MULTIPLE USE: You can use canning jars to store fruits, vegetables, sauces, syrups and other condiments. These 16 oz regular mouth mason jars are also an ideal option for holding treats, snacks, arts and crafts supplies and more. The clear glass jars could be a great addition to any product line.
KEEP FRESH: Includes matching regular mouth lids to help seal in freshness and flavor. Ball glass jars are ideal for the storage of of dry foods and snacks such as sugar, beans, peas, rice, oats, flour, pasta, cookies, crackers, and candies
REGULAR MOUTH: Wide opening (2 ¾-inch diameter) on the glass jar makes it easy to scoop out dry goods. The silver caps make for very elegant closures for many products. The wide mouth allows for easy accessibility to the bottom of the mason jar for easy and thorough cleaning by hand with a wet cloth.
USE & CARE: Each pack includes 4 pieces crystal-clear glass mason jars with silver lids, 16oz. Made of glass and BPA-free. Dishwasher safe.

reviews_1s:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Not Recommended for Actual Canning

Unfortunately, these jars are more about looks than function. Two have already cracked under normal use, and the lids rust far too easily. If you’re looking for jars for serious canning or long-term storage, these are not a good choice. They’re fine for decorative or light use, but I would not trust them for preserving food. Disappointed overall.I had to order a set of these jars twice because the first set included broken jars. The second (unbroken) set leaks, even when you put the lids on carefully and tightly. They are cheaply made and poor quality. If you need them for a craft project, they might work but do not use with liquids.

Update about 2 weeks later - one of them started leaking when i put liquid in it. They are cheap and poorly made. The tops also do not seal. Do not buy these for liquids or food.The cap is cheap, very hard to open, and doesn't close properly after opening. Glass is fine, top is horrible. Can find a better one from another seller.Not worth. It's made of cheap, brittle glass. and it doesn't feel sturdy. I was using a metal spoon to stir some lemon black tea in it, and it broke on the second time.I bought a 4-pack of these jars. The first one I gave as a gift to a friend with a homemade margarita inside. She told me that when she opened the jar, the entire bottom of the jar busted out, leaving a sticky mess everywhere. I thought that was a fluke. Last week, my daughter was mixing chocolate syrup into milk in one of these jars and, right before my very eyes, the entire jar seemed to explode for no reason. What the heck-I've never seen anything like it. I threw out the last two jars. They were not worth the potential mess they might create.The jar broke when I poured lemon juice into it. While cheap, I wouldn't recommend purchasing as they're unsafe to use.The jars came just fine and not broken, the seal is nice and they are good sized for the price but one issue... there are tiny dead bugs that look almost like lice. I'm too afraid to open them and clean them out.The lids are very low quality. Once the thin layer of paint got scratched along the thread, they started to rust immediately.Jar seemed nice until I tapped a spoon on the inside of it to dislodge food adhering to the spoon.
